rounds.text: Piccadily Sugar & Allied Inds Ltd trades at an extreme trailing price-to-earnings multiple of 231x based on filed statements [E1], while its price-to-book ratio sits at an elevated 5.55x [E2]. The underlying operational reality starkly contradicts this heavy valuation, evidenced by a catastrophic operating margin of -148% in March 2026, which has deteriorated by 127 percentage points over three years from -21% [E30]. Long-term fundamental decay is further confirmed by a poor 5-year sales growth of -41.3% [E51] and a negative 5-year compounded profit growth of -17% [E19]. Adding to the downside risks, the stock languishes near the bottom of its yearly trajectory at only 14% of the way up its 52-week range [E5], offers zero dividend yield [E4], and struggles with decelerating earnings growth [E62]. Conceded: the company shows strong recent operational acceleration including a 111% TTM profit growth, a massive 1114% YoY sales spike, and significant capital expenditure through a 30% rise in CWIP to Rs 56.35 Cr [E18, E21, E41, E57].
